mapper.select: SELECT CONCAT(table_name, '.', column_name) FROM information_schema.columns WHERE table_schema = database() AND ( (table_name = 'wms_company' AND column_name IN ('company_id', 'enabled', 'lifecycle_status')) OR (table_name = 'wms_warehouse' AND column_name IN ('warehouse_id', 'company_id', 'lifecycle_status')) OR (table_name = 'wms_warehouse_zone' AND column_name IN ( 'zone_id', 'warehouse_id', 'parent_zone_id', 'zone_kind', 'lifecycle_status', 'del_flag' )) OR (table_name = 'wms_storage' AND column_name IN ( 'storage_id', 'warehouse_id', 'zone_id', 'lifecycle_status', 'del_flag' )) ) ORDER BY table_name, column_name
mapper.sql: c.company_id, c.lifecycle_status AS company_lifecycle_status, w.warehouse_id, w.company_id AS warehouse_company_id, w.lifecycle_status AS warehouse_lifecycle_status, s.storage_id AS space_id, s.warehouse_id AS space_warehouse_id, s.zone_id AS zone_id, s.lifecycle_status AS space_lifecycle_status, s.del_flag AS space_del_flag, dz.parent_zone_id AS device_zone_parent_zone_id

choose.when: SELECT z.zone_id AS scope_id, w.company_id, z.warehouse_id, z.parent_zone_id, z.zone_kind, z.del_flag FROM wms_warehouse_zone z JOIN wms_warehouse w ON w.warehouse_id = z.warehouse_id WHERE z.zone_id = #{scopeId}
SELECT s.storage_id AS scope_id, w.company_id, s.warehouse_id, s.del_flag FROM wms_storage s JOIN wms_warehouse w ON w.warehouse_id = s.warehouse_id WHERE s.storage_id = #{scopeId}
